title: Each role definition declares exactly its contract's tools, checked in every cell
summary: The three role definitions declare the tool list their contract derives, and a missing or empty declaration fails the role-definition check (TSK-0051, against ACC-0072). SCOPE. This is a STATIC check of what the three shipped definitions declare. No specialist process was launched and none is claimed: what a real child actually receives - its active tool set, and its inherited provider, model and thinking level - is ACC-0076's measurement under TSK-0053, which owns the delegation runtime. GENERATED, NOT AUTHORED. `specialists/research.md`, `specialists/planning.md` and `specialists/validation.md` are rendered from the authored prose in `lib/specialists/roles.mjs` merged with `contractFor(role)`. The authored set is closed at seven fields and a test proves the prose names no tool, so the declared list cannot be a second, unchecked statement of the allowlist. `contractFor(role).tools` resolves capabilities first, then the write boundary's creates, then its mutations, each group sorted, and is empty when the contract reports anything unimplemented or unknown - so a definition is never written over a contract promising a tool nothing registers. THE DERIVED LISTS. research: research_capability, research_fetch, research_search, kiln_create_assertion, kiln_create_evidence, kiln_create_question, kiln_link_evidence, kiln_unlink_evidence. planning: kiln_create_assertion, kiln_create_decision, kiln_create_question, kiln_create_requirement, kiln_create_runbook_step, kiln_link_evidence, kiln_resolve_question, kiln_revise_artifact, kiln_set_lifecycle, kiln_unlink_evidence. validation: validation_capability, validation_run, kiln_create_evidence, kiln_link_evidence. NO READ-ONLY TOOL IS OFFERED, and a test names five and asserts each is absent from every role. A specialist receives a task-scoped payload; kiln_project_status would show it the whole project. THE WIRE NAMES ARE STATED TWICE AND COMPARED. `lib/tool-wire-names.mjs` holds the map because `lib/` must not import the package; `pi-package/extensions/kiln.js` spells the same names out because a measured fixture proves it must load with nothing but `pi-package/` present. Neither can import the other, so `test/tool-wire-names.test.mjs` compares them in both directions and against the registry. AN EMPTY OR MISSING DECLARATION FAILS. The closed reader refuses `tools:` absent as a missing key, present-but-empty as `tools-empty`, written inline as `tools-not-a-list`, and a repeated entry as `tools-duplicate`; the plan refuses a list that disagrees with the contract as `tools-do-not-match-contract`, naming both lists; and the renderer refuses to produce a file for a role deriving no tools at all. Each is stated separately from byte equality, which would catch them all but would not say which.

facts.ci-found-a-defect: the first push at 5c20d39 failed all four cells. The plan resolved a definition's path before asking what the entry was, so a symlink pointing outside the directory was reported as a path escape rather than as a link. The test had passed locally only because the development host refuses symlink creation and the case returned silently. The kind is now decided by lstat before anything is resolved, the test asserts a link out of the directory and a link inside it are both reported as links, and it records a skip rather than returning silently when a host cannot create one. Fixed at 587b4bf; no cell was re-run
